title: The Spore Balloon Rescue
story: High over the Fenlight Marsh, Mr 6 clings to a mushroom-silk balloon carrying two lost goat-herders. Quassomere the Puffdrift Warden, a bloated spore-creature, has nibbled a hole in the envelope, and the balloon is sinking at 14.5 feet every minute. Mr 6 can vent hot steam into the envelope to rise, but the steam only pushes up 11.5 feet per minute, and the balloon is 54 feet above the safe landing mound.
question: If Mr 6 vents steam the whole way down, how many minutes until the balloon touches the landing mound?
solution: The real sinking speed is 14.5 - 11.5 = 3 feet each minute.
The balloon lands gently in 18 minutes.
praise: Subtracting the two speeds is exactly the right first move — the next step was dividing the 54 feet by that difference.
hint: The balloon sinks AND rises at the same time. What's the leftover sinking speed each minute?
victory: The balloon settled onto the mound like a sleepy pudding, and Quassomere — who had never once been given a soft landing — asked politely if he could ride along next time.
imagePrompt: A patched mushroom-silk balloon drifting down over a glowing green marsh at dusk, a bloated spore-warden puffing beside it, while a little knightly numeral 6 in a blue cape works the steam valve with two rescued goat-herders clutching the basket.
